name: Martyrdom
overview: Scripture reveals martyrdom as a profound testimony to faithfulness amid persecution, beginning with Abel, who was slain by his brother Cain after offering unto the LORD. The prophets faced deadly opposition, notably from Jezebel who cut off many of the LORD's prophets, and Doeg who slew priests at Nob, demonstrating the severe cost of standing for God's truth. This pattern culminates in the ultimate martyrdom of Jesus, underscoring the spiritual reality that those who remain faithful to God's covenant may face lethal hostility for their testimony.
